name: Porcine Eye Model Construction
aliases: Ex vivo porcine eye geometric model
definition: A geometric optical model of an ex vivo porcine eye used to simulate ray tracing for distortion correction, accounting for differences in curvature and thickness compared to human eyes.
summary: Porcine Eye Model Construction defines ex vivo porcine eye geometry for OCT ray tracing, differing from human models by accounting for specific corneal curvature, lens thickness, and gradient refractive index properties.
